runs.summary: 3 new recipes: Roast Sausages with Grapes, Galbi-jjim, Moules au Cidre
runs.content:
1. Roast Sausages with Red Grapes, Red Onion and Mustard Mash, inspired by Nigel Slater. A 40-minute one-tray weeknight supper where October grapes roast into a jammy, sharp pan sauce.
2. Galbi-jjim (Korean Braised Short Ribs with Daikon and Chestnuts), inspired by David Chang. A weekend braise in soy, pear and garlic that reduces to a sticky glaze, with seasonal chestnuts.
3. Moules au Cidre with Crusty Bread, inspired by Anthony Bourdain. The wild card: a 20-minute Normandy-style brasserie classic with mussels at their October best.

runs.summary: 3 new recipes: Pork Chops with Apples and Cider, Pho Bo, Miso-Butter Roast Squash
runs.content:
1. Pork Chops with Apples, Sage and Cider Pan Sauce, inspired by Lucinda Scala Quinn. A 30-minute one-pan weeknight supper: sear, rest, deglaze with the first cider of autumn.
2. Pho Bo (Hanoi-Style Beef Noodle Soup), inspired by Anthony Bourdain. A weekend project with charred aromatics and a clear, spiced broth from his favourite city.
3. Miso-Butter Roast Squash with Chilli Crunch and Spring Onion, inspired by David Chang. The wild card: peak-season squash with umami and heat.
